notes.title: After 5 years... a major update saunters in through the batwing doors
notes.notes:
After several years, a major patch has been released for Boot Hill Heroes that improves the game in several ways.  This patch mostly carries over enhancements in the sequel, Boot Hill Bounties, but there are some interesting updates as well:


 Updated Menus and Interface: The cleaner, slicker interface from Boot Hill Bounties is here with more readable text and colors.
 Several sprites have been remade: Including the Weezler, Razor Paw, and most of the Saints-Little Gang.
 Food is able to be found or purchased as in Boot Hill Bounties:  You can buy food from restaurants and eat it there or store it in your inventory for later.  Food gives characters a variety of perks that will come in handy.
 Medical Kits can also be purchased:  You can purchase Medical Kits from doctors in towns to heal wounds while on adventures.
 Updated Script:  Some sections of the script have been rewritten, mostly dialogue of the Chepakwik to better connect to Boot Hill Bounties
 Postgame Content Changes: The riddles to opening the doors in the Cinnabar Mines now pertain to things in Kickstart Creek (as opposed to all over Bronco County).  Also, a new final boss has been added.
